text_block_list.text: Fufu. That was a nice fight.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"We are rough diamonds that shine when 
polished. The important thing is to 
believe in our potential and never give 
up."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's come back and challenge it again 
next time!
